title: Reconstructing hair, eyes and teeth from images

queue.claim: Code and pretrained priors for the main strand methods (Neural Haircut, GaussianHaircut, MonoHair, DiffLocks, Perm, HAAR) are mostly licensed for research or non-commercial use only, so they must stay an optional plug-in that runs in a separate process and is never bundled.
queue.query: GaussianHaircut Neural Haircut DiffLocks MonoHair github license non-commercial

queue.claim: Average crown sizes (Wheeler-type textbook values), length × mesiodistal width: upper central incisor 10.5 × 8.5 mm, upper lateral 9.0 × 6.5, upper canine 10.0 × 7.5, lower central 9.0 × 5.0, lower lateral 9.5 × 5.5, lower canine 11.0 × 7.0 mm. Upper intercanine width 33–37 mm, lower 25–28 mm.
queue.query: Wheeler dental anatomy table crown length mesiodistal diameter maxillary central incisor 10.5 8.5

queue.claim: The upper eyelid margin follows vertical gaze with an angular gain of roughly 0.6–1.0. The fitting prior is g ~ N(0.8, 0.2²).
queue.query: upper eyelid position vertical gaze relationship linear gain degrees eyelid excursion

queue.claim: DiffLocks (CVPR 2025) reconstructs strands, including curly and coily hair, from a single image. It was trained on about 40k synthetic hairstyles generated in Blender and is the strongest single-image strand prior I recall. Low-confidence recall of 2025–26 successors: Im2Haircut, TANGLED, StrandHead, SimAvatar.
queue.query: DiffLocks single image 3D hair strands diffusion 40K hairstyles Im2Haircut 2025
